maria: Quick design check — compact rules-list skeleton + keyboard/ARIA flow. maria: Pushed a tiny PR with skeleton + placeholder states: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234 oliver: Nice start. Spacing feels tight in mobile. Can we bump item padding to 12px vertical? :thinking_face: sam: Also the reorder placeholder is hard to see — when dragging the ghost is only 4px high. drew: Proposal: show 2px dashed outline + subtle drop-shadow when dragging. Add aria-live announcement 'Moved "Rule name" to position 3'. ava: Copy suggestion for validation: change "Priority conflict" -> "Two rules share the same priority. Choose a unique order to resolve which rule runs first." Shorter alt: 'Duplicate priority — pick an order.' oliver: Accessibility nit — color of the drag handle (#6B7280) fails AA on light bg. Suggest #374151 or add a visible focus ring. sam: Keyboard: when using Ctrl+Arrow to move, the live region should announce the new index and focused control. Current behavior only focuses, no announcement. sam: Quick snippet we can reuse: ```
Moved 'Block external ips' to position 2
``` maria: Good snippet — let's standardize on role=status and polite. Also add `aria-atomic="true"` so partial updates don't read weirdly. simulator-bot: Simulation preview updated — added example traffic toggles and empty-state copy. drew: UX question: preview's "Simulate" CTA sits under the fold on smaller screens. Can we make the preview sticky or add a lightweight toolbar with Simulate + Clear? ava: Also tweak preview empty copy: current 'No preview data' -> 'No simulated traffic yet — open the simulator or upload a csv to preview rule ordering.' maria: Action items: 1) bump padding + adjust handle color (oliver) 2) implement outlined drop target + aria-live (drew/sam) 3) apply copy updates (ava) 4) fix preview CTA placement (drew) 5) standardize aria snippet in components (sam) oliver: SGTM :thumbsup: sam: I'll pair with Drew tomorrow to wire up the live region. ava: I'll PR the copy changes today. maria: Thanks all — tagging in UX review on Thursday 10am PST. :calendar:
